Muted categorical.use_case: Up to 6 groups in bar/line plots

Sequential (single hue).use_case: Ordered data, density, magnitude (light = low, dark = high)

Diverging.use_case: Data with a meaningful midpoint (e.g. log-fold change)

Color families.use_case: Seven hues with five shades each (lighter, light, base, dark, darker), for tints and shades of one hue, fills with matching outlines, or theme colors. Not for categorical data: use the categorical palettes for that.

Neutrals.use_case: Non-data elements and missing values. Roles refer to steps of the grey ramp.

theme.use_case: Primary, secondary and tertiary colors for titles, highlights and layout. Independent of the data palettes and meant to be swapped to match the design of the report or paper. Add a theme under 'themes' and set 'active'. Defaults are placeholders.

Project type (Wiggins and Crowston).use_case: Fixed color per type, identical in every chart; red is deliberately unused so no red/green pair appears. Always add direct labels, not color alone.

Pocock axes.use_case: Ordered scales: draw from the sequential palette, never the categorical one
